title: Copilot — IDE and Plugin Version Compliance
description: Fleet-wide view of IDE versions and Copilot plugin versions in use. Enables IT and platform teams to track version adoption and identify users on outdated plugin versions.

options.content:
## Copilot IDE and Plugin Version Compliance

Fleet-wide tracking of which IDEs and Copilot plugin versions are in use across the developer population. This data is stored in Loki as structured fields in the per-user daily log records. VictoriaMetrics stores IDE as a high-cardinality label but does not retain version detail in a queryable form.

**Key questions answered:**
- Which IDEs are developers using with Copilot?
- Which Copilot plugin versions are installed across the fleet?
- Which users are on older plugin versions?
- How quickly are developers adopting new plugin releases?

**Note:** IDE and plugin version data comes from `totals_by_ide` array in each log record. The array shows the last known version per IDE per user per day.

**Data source:** Loki `totals_by_ide` field — 28-day query window maximum.

panels.title: Distinct IDEs in Use (28d)
panels.description: Number of distinct IDE types used with Copilot across the enterprise in the last 28 days.

panels.title: Users With IDE Data (28d)
panels.description: Number of distinct users who have IDE breakdown data in Loki logs in the last 28 days.

panels.title: CLI Users (28d)
panels.description: Number of distinct users who used Copilot CLI in the last 28 days. CLI usage is tracked separately from IDE usage.

panels.title: IDE Breakdown — Raw Log Records
panels.description: Raw log records showing the totals_by_ide array per user per day. Each line shows a user's IDE breakdown including IDE name, version, plugin version, prompt count, and LOC added. Use this to inspect specific users or look for version patterns. Filter by username using Grafana's log search.

targets.expr: {enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | totals_by_ide != "[]" | line_format "user={{.user_login}} day={{.day}} ides={{.totals_by_ide}}"

panels.title: CLI Users by Version (28d)
panels.description: Users who used Copilot CLI in the last 28 days with their CLI version details. Use this to track CLI version adoption and identify users on older CLI versions who may need to update. CLI version detail is stored in the cli_version field of the Loki log record.

targets.expr: {enterprise="$enterprise", log_source="copilot_exporter"} | json | used_cli="true" | line_format "user={{.user_login}} day={{.day}} cli_version={{.cli_version}} sessions={{.cli_session_count}} prompts={{.cli_prompt_count}}"
